# Columns (tab-separated): audio file name in the folder, its Drive id, the photo it was read from, the text.

# out (the scorer ignores it and spaces). The photo of 5.mp3 is handwritten, so its text is the least certain.
# Tfc-list.mp3 has no photo and is not here.
